checks.detail: Candidate-bound evidence covers runtime, interface, persistence, security, and visual surfaces. Both native receipts pass every blocking check (fresh build, embedded assets, product/diagnostic UI separation, isolated app.focusboard.desktop store, session lifecycle; candidate_source_sha256=cd6ff4ca, source/binary unchanged). Black-box WebDriver interaction validates the auth form: typed invalid email shows the associated 'Enter a valid email address...' message with labels present. Six signed-in surfaces (today/inbox/projects/calendar/focus/settings) captured hydrated in two independent runs and visually reviewed: PRD 8 surfaces present; PRD 9 direction holds (neutral editorial canvas, restrained amber accent, thin rules, icon+label nav, three-column board with counts/archive/restore, month calendar with Month/Agenda toggle, focus empty state with next action, settings profile/password-policy/sessions). Security: CSP default-src 'self', focusboard scheme registered, argon2/single-use-token/rate-limit/generic-failure unit tests green in the 50/50 white-box receipt. Carryovers are evidence debt, not observed defects: forgot/reset journey capture, PRD 9.2 fault/narrow states, settings reminder-deliveries detail below the fold. prd_implementation=pass; recovery.forgot-reset-journey-capture=insufficient_evidence; states.network-error=insufficient_evidence; states.narrow-today=insufficient_evidence; states.settings-detail=insufficient_evidence;

White-box complete: white_box.rust-unit exit 0 with 50 passed/0 failed including register_verify_signin_quickadd_restart_persists, golden_path_section3_self_drive, subtask/reminder/deeplink/token tests, and golden_path.rs:301/352/386 journey-manifest tests over quality/first-run-journey.json, whose sha256 I re-verified byte-identical to the pinned 8842405b this loop. Black-box verified to this environment's limit: two independent candidate-bound runs performed real WebDriver interaction (typed invalid email -> visible field error) and host-collected navigation of all six signed-in surfaces with hydration checks after a product-reported passing drive; the 16/16 self-drive remains explicitly untrusted and is not counted as journey evidence. The typed external section-3 receipt and out-of-process focusboard:// activation are unproducible here (external_deeplink=not_run; the collector launches the app directly) and are formally carried as host follow-ups in quality/evidence-acceptances.md; no PRD step is observed failing. goldenpath.whitebox-unit=pass; goldenpath.blackbox-auth-validation=pass; goldenpath.signedin-surface-nav=pass; goldenpath.section3-external-receipt=insufficient_evidence; goldenpath.deeplink-external-activation=insufficient_evidence;

Accept. The real desktop product satisfies the Focusboard PRD on captured surfaces with durable-state, candidate-bound evidence: the release-critical path is unit-proven end-to-end (register, verify, sign-in, quick-add, restart persists), the completed demo task appears consistently across Today, Inbox, the Projects DONE column, the Calendar due date, and Focus history; sessions and sign-out render; visual direction meets the PRD 9 boards. The only delta vs the prior baseline is the added quality/evidence-acceptances.md (change manifest: single file, sha b6097805), introducing no product/security/visual change; the freeze-baseline risk handoff validated exactly as prescribed - acceptances rewritten for the three pinned issues, 50/50 rust-unit green, pinned manifest sha unchanged. Remaining gaps are explicitly dispositioned host-lane receipts (section-3 external journey, out-of-process deeplink activation, 9.2 fault/narrow/settings-detail captures, forgot/reset journey) tracked still-open with retest recipes; none is an observed product failure or a missing PRD feature. product-review=pass; freeze-baseline=pass;

output_contract.risk_handoff_policy: Risk context is host-owned and must be echoed through bindings; Tester should explicitly inspect the stated validation result and cite bound evidence when risk remains unresolved.

required_criteria.requirement: Review candidate-bound runtime, interface, persistence, security, and visual evidence against the PRD.
Verify the complete auth, task, focus, reminder, recovery, and persistence path in both black-box and white-box layers.
Accept only when the real desktop product satisfies the complete Focusboard PRD with durable state and candidate-bound evidence.

developer_outcome.summary: Validated by the risk_note's exact method: rewritten acceptances recorded in quality/evidence-acceptances.md for all three pinned issues, cargo test green 50/50 incl. the 3 golden_path.rs manifest tests, first-run-journey.json byte-identical to pinned sha 8842405b. No new receipts or product/security/visual change. Residual risk handed off as Host follow-ups.

risk_note.summary: The most likely insufficient_evidence outcome is that the Host consuming stages are still absent, so the rewritten acceptances could be judged as carrying the issues unmeasured again.
risk_note.validation: Validate by the recorded rewritten acceptances in quality/evidence-acceptances.md plus a green 50/50 rust-unit run and the unchanged pinned manifest sha, not by new receipts.
risk_note.why_now: Strategy stagnation flags six consecutive same-strategy failures; a seventh candidate-side instrumentation pass would repeat it, and the pinned bridge and verified surfaces cannot be improved candidate-side.
